summary.offline_reverification: PASS (8 raw bodies re-hash identically; all verdicts re-derived)

findings.finding: worker-028 recorded PARTIAL for SRC-060/068/076/087/088 (artifacts/worker-028/l1_uncovered_spotcheck/uncovered_spotcheck_028.json#44e356c6fd3c). All five are re-derived here as fully supported: SRC-060/068/087 CONFIRMED_METADATA (every declared Crossref field matches: title, author surname, volume, issue, pages, published date, DOI, reference-count where present) and SRC-076/088 CONFIRMED_ABSTRACT (every '...'-separated fragment is a normalized verbatim substring of the fetched abstract). No content mismatch was found.
findings.falsifier: Re-fetch SRC-060/068/076/087/088 from the locators recorded in the artifact and produce a declared field or a >=8-token excerpt fragment that is absent from the fetched record.

findings.finding: The five PARTIAL verdicts have two instrument causes, neither a ledger defect: (a) for SRC-060/068/087 the ledger excerpt is a Crossref metadata rendering ('Crossref record: title ... author ... volume ... DOI ...') and the Crossref record carries no abstract, so an abstract-substring test cannot succeed (028 recorded excerpt 'not_available' for SRC-060 and 'partial' for SRC-068/087); (b) for SRC-076/088 the ledger legitimately uses '...' elisions inside the excerpt, which a whole-string substring test reports as a miss. Comparing declared metadata field-by-field, and testing each elision-separated fragment separately, removes both false PARTIALs.
findings.falsifier: Show a row where the field-by-field / per-fragment method returns CONFIRMED while a naive whole-excerpt substring test returns MATCH (that would mean the new method is weaker, not that the PARTIAL was an artifact).

findings.finding: Class tokens are reported, not adjudicated. Of the 8 sampled rows, 4 (SRC-059/060/087/088) carry '(evidence/tag only)' in class_mapping and 4 of the 5 contested rows are mirrors of other ledger rows (SRC-060 mirror_of SRC-020, SRC-068 mirror_of SRC-002, SRC-087 mirror_of SRC-024, SRC-088 mirror_of SRC-033). The two sampled rows that do carry class tokens, SRC-063 (AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN;AF-WCC-VAC-GEN) and SRC-079 (AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN;AF-WCC-VAC-GEN), both carry disjunctive two-class tokens, the literal pattern the A0 rubric names as class leakage (HF-02). Routed to the pending HF-02 detector-scope ruling; this review does not adjudicate it.
findings.falsifier: Recount class_mapping for rows 59,60,63,68,76,79,87,88 at ledger hash 315c19145065 and obtain a different token census.

findings.finding: For SRC-063 and SRC-079 the row's exact_locator is an arXiv discovery query (search_query=...), and for SRC-076 it contains a literal '...'; these are not record locators by construction. The fetch therefore used the row's record identifier (arXiv id from evidence_url, Crossref DOI, INSPIRE recid). This is a specific instance of the already-recorded HF-W005-L0-01 / W025-L1L-F2 locator-column defect (reviews/L1-locator-adjudication-025.json#9e4deca54af6, artifacts/worker-025/l1_locator_adj/report.json#26f0071c558e), not a new hard failure, and it does not affect the excerpt comparison.
findings.falsifier: Show that any of the three exact_locator values is a primary page/record URL that resolves to the cited work.

findings.finding: The driver runs six mutation controls and eight positive controls in-band: all six mutations are detected (DOI digit, title exponent T^3->T^4, title content-word insertion, author surname mutation, fabricated abstract sentence, one-word substitution inside a fragment) and all eight unmutated rows pass. The artifact re-verifies offline from the stored raw bodies, re-hashing each to the recorded sha256 and re-deriving every verdict.
findings.falsifier: Run artifacts/flash-10/l1_spotcheck/run_spotcheck_010.py --offline: the control claim is falsified if any mutation control fails to fire, any positive control fires, or any raw body re-hashes differently.

recommendation.preferred: Treat the five worker-028 PARTIAL rows as resolved in the ledger's favour for excerpt/metadata support, and record the two instrument causes (metadata rendering vs elision) in the G-LIT evidence binder so a future spot check does not re-open them. Do not repair the ledger on account of this review.
